help.title: How this helps you get hired
help.body: Applicant tracking systems (ATS) filter most resumes before a human ever sees them. Paste the job description and CVPower shows how well your resume matches — and exactly what to change to pass the filter and reach the interview. Think of it as a practice run against the specific job you're applying to.
help.point1: Match score — your fit for this specific job, from 0 to 100.
help.point2: Score breakdown — keyword coverage, skills match, ATS-friendliness, quantified impact, readability, and completeness.
help.point3: Gaps — the required skills and keywords you're missing, shown as matched, partial, or missing.
help.point4: Recommendations — concrete, ranked fixes, each labeled with the points it can add.
help.step1: Choose the resume to analyze at the top.
help.step2: Paste the full job description on the left.
help.step3: Review your score, its breakdown, and the gaps on the right.
help.step4: Apply the recommendations in the builder, then come back — your score updates live.
help.privacy: Everything runs on your device. Your resume and the job description are never uploaded.
